children: Methode Electronics reported fiscal first quarter 2027 results with net sales of $265.4 million, up 10.4% year-over-year, and a net loss of $11.4 million ($0.32 diluted). Adjusted EBITDA was $13.7 million for the quarter and the company affirmed its fiscal 2027 guidance. Management highlighted growth in the Industrial segment led by data center volumes, booked $75 million of new non-data center peak annual awards, and completed an amendment to extend certain credit facility maturities to October 2028.
Net sales: $265.4 million for the three months ended August 1, 2026 (up from $240.5 million).
Gross profit: $47.7 million (compared with $43.5 million in prior-year quarter).
Loss from operations: $(3.9) million; Adjusted loss from operations: $(2.2) million.
Net loss: $(11.4) million, or $(0.32) per diluted share; Adjusted net loss: $(7.7) million, or $(0.22) per diluted share.
Adjusted EBITDA: $13.7 million (5.2% of net sales); EBITDA: $12.0 million (4.5% of net sales).
Industrial segment led revenue growth: Industrial net sales rose to $156.8 million, a 27.0% increase driven by higher volumes for data center, on-highway and off-highway lighting products.
Automotive segment: Net sales were $105.7 million, essentially flat year-over-year, with operating loss narrowing slightly due to improved performance partially offset by higher SG&A.
Interface segment revenue declined to $2.9 million following the divestiture of the dataMate business and consumer appliance program roll-offs.
Booked new non-data center awards totaling $75 million of peak annual revenue (approximately $400 million lifetime), indicating continued commercial momentum.

Balance sheet and liquidity actions: Net repayment of debt of $10.1 million during the quarter and subsequent amendment to extend certain maturities of the revolving credit facility one year to October 2028 (facility reduced from $400M to $375M at closing).
